requirements.title: Create test plan from Test Cases selection
requirements.description: QA selects manual test cases on the Test Cases tab and creates a plan from the selection; plan metadata is edited in the inspector.

requirements.title: Auto-include linked automation in plans
requirements.description: Adding a manual case to a plan adds linked automated tests; unlinking manual removes paired automation from the plan.

requirements.title: Plans list with filters
requirements.description: Scrollable plan table with name search and release/sprint filters.

requirements.title: Plan case catalog for membership editing
requirements.description: Dense filterable catalog with in-plan toggles, bulk add/remove, and full-project case list.

requirements.title: Plan metadata panel
requirements.description: Right panel for plan fields only; cases managed on the left.

requirements.title: Quick view test case from plan catalog
requirements.description: Dismissible read-only popup for case summary from Plans catalog.

requirements.title: Automation visibility without spec detail
requirements.description: Coverage icon on manual rows; automation specs remain under Automation tab.

requirements.title: Execute automation from Runs
requirements.description: Optional execute-automated on run create; default off. Not on Plans tab.

requirements.title: Embedded run report section
requirements.description: Run detail report panel for embedded HTML (Allure-style attachment).

requirements.title: Bulk selection across filters
requirements.description: Selection persists across filters; select-all-matching uses current filter set.
